fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: BANK CODE
fields.description: Bank clearing code of the reporting bank as issued by Kenya Banker's Association (KBA)

fields.name: BRANCH ID
fields.description: Branch code where the account was opened/operated from.

fields.name: BUSINESS REPORTING DAY, MONTH & YEAR
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: ACCOUNT/CONTRACT NUMBER
fields.description: Unique account identifier as assigned to customers' accounts by the reporting institution.

fields.name: CUSTOMER ID
fields.description: Customer unique identifier linked to the account.

fields.name: ID NUMBER/ PASSPORT NO/ REG NO.
fields.payload_key: ID NUMBER PASSPORT NO REG NO
fields.description: Unique registration identification number, passport number or registration certificate number assigned to registered corporates by the Registrar of Companies.

fields.name: TRANSACTION DATE
fields.description: The date that the transaction took place.

fields.name: ISO CURRENCY CODE
fields.description: ISO currency codes as per ISO-4217. {e.g. USD, GPB, EUR, KES. etc.}
